name: secure-web-app
displayName: Secure Web App Baseline (WAF + Private Data)
description: Network-hardened App Service with private SQL and Key Vault behind private endpoints, fronted by Application Gateway with WAF.
what: A Linux App Service integrated into a VNet, talking to Azure SQL and Key Vault exclusively over private endpoints with private DNS. The only public ingress is an Application Gateway running an OWASP WAF policy in Prevention mode. Connectivity to SQL is passwordless via managed identity.
why: Most regulated web workloads cannot expose data services to the public internet or accept unfiltered inbound traffic. This baseline closes both gaps while keeping a passwordless, observable, zone-redundant footprint.
potentialUseCases: Customer-facing portal handling regulated or PII data
Internal line-of-business app reachable only through WAF
Lift-and-shift of a public web app into a private-networking posture
PCI-scoped checkout or account-management front end

reliability: Zone-redundant App Service plan and Application Gateway in prod
Health probe drives gateway backend health
security: SQL and Key Vault reachable only via private endpoints (public access disabled)
Passwordless SQL access via managed identity and Entra-only auth
OWASP 3.2 WAF in Prevention mode is the sole public entry point
costOptimization: Serverless SQL and P0v3 plan in dev
Application Gateway autoscales between a floor and ceiling
operationalExcellence: Application Insights and Log Analytics wired in
Secrets referenced from Key Vault rather than stored in config
performanceEfficiency: HTTP/2 enabled and Always On for warm instances
Gateway autoscale matches capacity to load

quota.summary: App Service Premium v3 compute is needed in the target region. Azure SQL and Application Gateway have no blocking regional quota gate.

requirements.detail: The App Service plan needs available compute (vCPU) quota for the chosen SKU. Zone redundancy requires >= 3 instances.

cost.profile: Zone-redundant prod profile: P1v3 x3, GP_Gen5_2 SQL, WAF_v2 gateway.

components.name: Application Gateway WAF_v2
components.notes: Fixed gateway hours; capacity units billed separately.

components.name: Azure SQL (GP_Gen5_2)
components.notes: 2 vCores x 730 hours, General Purpose provisioned. Priced per vCore-hour.
